verses.text: The elder, To [the] chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all those having known the truth—

segments.text: The elder, To [the] chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not only I, but also all those having known the truth—

verses.text: because of the truth remaining in us and [that] will be with us to the age:

segments.text: because of the truth remaining in us and [that] will be with us to the age:

verses.text: Grace, mercy, [and] peace will be with us from God [the] Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

segments.text: Grace, mercy, [and] peace will be with us from God [the] Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

verses.text: I rejoiced exceedingly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received a commandment from the Father.

segments.text: I rejoiced exceedingly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received a commandment from the Father.

verses.text: And now I ask you, lady, not as writing to you a new commandment, but that which we have had from [the] beginning, that we should love one another.

segments.text: And now I ask you, lady, not as writing to you a new commandment, but that which we have had from [the] beginning, that we should love one another.

verses.text: And this is love, that we should walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, just as you⁺ heard from [the] beginning, so that you⁺ should walk in it.

segments.text: And this is love, that we should walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, just as you⁺ heard from [the] beginning, so that you⁺ should walk in it.

verses.text: For many deceivers went out into the world, those not confessing Jesus Christ coming in flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.

segments.text: For many deceivers went out into the world, those not confessing Jesus Christ coming in flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.

verses.text: Watch yourselves, so that you⁺ may not lose what things we worked for, but you⁺ may receive a full reward.

segments.text: Watch yourselves, so that you⁺ may not lose what things we worked for, but you⁺ may receive a full reward.

verses.text: Everyone going on ahead and not remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. The [one] remaining in the teaching, this [one] has both the Father and the Son.

segments.text: Everyone going on ahead and not remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. The [one] remaining in the teaching, this [one] has both the Father and the Son.

verses.text: If anyone comes to you⁺ and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into [the] house, and do not speak to him to greet [him].

segments.text: If anyone comes to you⁺ and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into [the] house, and do not speak to him to greet [him].

verses.text: For the [one] speaking to him to greet [him] partakes in his evil works.

segments.text: For the [one] speaking to him to greet [him] partakes in his evil works.

verses.text: Having many things to write to you⁺, I intended not with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you⁺ and to speak mouth to mouth, so that our joy may be full.

segments.text: Having many things to write to you⁺, I intended not with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you⁺ and to speak mouth to mouth, so that our joy may be full.

verses.text: The children of your chosen sister greet you.
